# Nils Davoine

AI engineer in Luxembourg. I build RAG and LLM features that run in production.

**In production.** Two RAG assistants for an accounting firm in Luxembourg, used by its staff since August 2026: a document assistant over PDFs, e-mails and scans in French, English and German (about 100 questions a week, about 6 s per answer), and an onboarding assistant for new staff. For the same firm I built the client portal and staff workstation, where each client company sees only its own data.

**Public work** (rebuilt on invented data, every number generated by a script):

- [rag-accounting-docs](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/rag-accounting-docs): hybrid RAG (BM25 + pgvector, RRF, reranking) with refusals and per-company isolation
- [rules-vs-llm-filing-bench](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/rules-vs-llm-filing-bench): hand-written rules against small LLMs, measured before adding AI
- [llm-structured-requests](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/llm-structured-requests): one sentence to a validated request, personal data filtered before the LLM
- [invoice-ocr-local](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/invoice-ocr-local): local OCR for invoices, coherence checks, EN 16931 / UBL export
- [multi-agent-video-pipeline](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/multi-agent-video-pipeline): agents with typed contracts and quality gates on the finished video
- [agir-client-portal-demos](https://github.com/NilsDavoine/agir-client-portal-demos): playable replicas of the client portal and staff workstation

**Research.** Three years of doctoral research in machine learning at the University of Luxembourg (2022-2025). Co-author of QCell, a quantum-mechanical dataset of biomolecular fragments, published in *AI for Science* (IOP Publishing), 2026: [DOI 10.1088/3050-287X/ae5267](https://doi.org/10.1088/3050-287X/ae5267).

Also founder of AiAllDesk.
